## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` — new functionality
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `refactor` / `perf` — no behavior change / performance
- [ ] `docs` / `test` / `build` / `ci` / `chore`
- [ ] Breaking change (`!` in title + `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer)

## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits (it becomes the squash commit message)
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] Documentation in `docs/` updated (API, requirements, CI…) if behavior changed
- [ ] `make lint typecheck test` passes locally
